nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$ have partial sums $A(n) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} f(k)$, let $\sigma \ge 0$ be a real number with $A(n) = O(n^\sigma)$ as $n \to \infty$, and let $s$ be a complex number with $\operatorname{Re} s > \sigma$ at which the Dirichlet series $\sum_{n \ge 1} f(n) n^{-s}$ converges absolutely. Then the Abel continuation $F_f$ of $f$ satisfies $F_f(s) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} f(n) n^{-s}$.
nodes.title: Abel continuation agrees with the Dirichlet series

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$ have partial sums $A(n) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} f(k)$ and summatory step function $S(t) = \sum_{1 \le k \le t} f(k)$ for real $t$, and let $\sigma$ be a real number with $A(n) = O(n^\sigma)$ as $n \to \infty$. Then for every $s \in \mathbb{C}$ with $\operatorname{Re} s > \sigma$, the Abel continuation satisfies $F_f(s) = s\,\mathcal{M}S(-s)$, where…
nodes.title: The Abel continuation as a Mellin transform

nodes.summary: For $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$ with partial sums $A(n) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} f(k)$, the Abel continuation of $f$ is the function $F_f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ given by
nodes.title: Abel continuation of a Dirichlet series

nodes.summary: For $a : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$, $\rho \in \mathbb{C}$ and $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the one-based partial sum $\sum_{k=1}^{n} (a(k) - \rho)$ equals $\sum_{k=1}^{n} a(k) - n\rho$.
nodes.title: Partial sums after subtracting a constant

nodes.summary: For $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$ and $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the one-based partial sum is $A(n) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} f(k)$; in particular $A(0) = 0$ and the value $f(0)$ is never used.
nodes.title: Partial sums of a coefficient sequence

nodes.summary: For $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$, the summatory step function $S(t) = \sum_{1 \le k \le t} f(k)$ satisfies $S(t) = 0$ for every real $t < 1$.
nodes.title: The summatory step function vanishes below one

nodes.summary: For $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$ with partial sums $A(n) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} f(k)$, the summatory step function of $f$ is the function $S : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{C}$ with $S(t) = A(\lfloor t \rfloor)$ for $t \ge 0$ and $S(t) = 0$ for $t < 0$. Equivalently, $S(t) = \sum_{1 \le k \le t} f(k)$ for every real $t$.
nodes.title: Summatory step function

nodes.summary: Let $a : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$, $\rho \in \mathbb{C}$ and $\sigma \in \mathbb{R}$, and suppose that the one-based partial sums $A(n) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} a(k)$ satisfy $A(n) - n\rho = O(n^{\sigma})$ as $n \to \infty$. Then the linear asymptotic Dirichlet continuation $L_{a,\rho}$ of $a$ with constant $\rho$ is complex analytic at every $s \in \mathbb{C}$ with $\operatorname{Re} s > \sigma$ and $s \neq 1$.
nodes.title: Analyticity of the linear asymptotic continuation away from $1$

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$ have partial sums $A(n) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} f(k)$, and let $\sigma$ be a real number with $A(n) = O(n^\sigma)$ as $n \to \infty$. Then the Abel continuation $F_f$ of $f$ is analytic on the half-plane $\{s \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{Re} s > \sigma\}$.
nodes.title: Analyticity of the Abel continuation

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$ have partial sums $A(n) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} f(k)$, and let $\sigma$ be a real number with $A(n) = O(n^\sigma)$ as $n \to \infty$. Then the Abel continuation $F_f$ of $f$ is complex differentiable at every $s \in \mathbb{C}$ with $\operatorname{Re} s > \sigma$.
nodes.title: Complex differentiability of the Abel continuation

nodes.summary: Let $a : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$, $\rho \in \mathbb{C}$ and $\sigma \in \mathbb{R}$. If the one-based partial sums $A(n) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} a(k)$ satisfy $A(n) - n\rho = O(n^{\sigma})$ as $n \to \infty$, then $\sum_{k=1}^{n} (a(k) - \rho) = O(n^{\sigma})$ as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Growth bound for the partial sums of a shifted sequence

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$ have partial sums $A(n) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} f(k)$ and summatory step function $S(t) = \sum_{1 \le k \le t} f(k)$, and let $\sigma$ be any real number with $A(n) = O(n^\sigma)$ as $n \to \infty$. Then $S(t) = O(t^\sigma)$ as $t \to \infty$ through the reals.
nodes.title: Growth of the summatory step function

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$ have summatory step function $S(t) = \sum_{1 \le k \le t} f(k)$. For every real $b$, $S(t) = O(t^{-b})$ as $t \to 0^+$.
nodes.title: The summatory step function is negligible near zero

nodes.summary: Let $a : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$ and $\rho \in \mathbb{C}$, let $L_{a,\rho}$ be the linear asymptotic Dirichlet continuation of $a$ with constant $\rho$, and let $F_{a-\rho}$ be the Abel continuation of the sequence $n \mapsto a(n) - \rho$. Let $\zeta_1 : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ be the function with $\zeta_1(s) = (s - 1)\,\zeta(s)$ for $s \neq 1$ and $\zeta_1(1) = 1$, where $\zeta$ is the Riemann zeta…
nodes.title: Cleared-denominator form of the linear asymptotic continuation

nodes.summary: For $a : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$ and $\rho \in \mathbb{C}$, the linear asymptotic Dirichlet continuation of $a$ with constant $\rho$ is the function $L_{a,\rho} : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ given by $L_{a,\rho}(s) = \rho\,\zeta(s) + F_{a-\rho}(s)$, where $\zeta$ is the Riemann zeta function and $F_{a-\rho}$ is the Abel continuation of the sequence $n \mapsto a(n) - \rho$.
nodes.title: Linear asymptotic Dirichlet continuation

nodes.summary: For every $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$, the summatory step function $t \mapsto \sum_{k=1}^{\lfloor t \rfloor} f(k)$ on $\mathbb{R}$ is locally integrable on the open half-line $(0, \infty)$: every $t > 0$ has a neighbourhood within $(0, \infty)$ on which this function is Lebesgue integrable.
nodes.title: Local integrability of the summatory function

nodes.summary: Let $a : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$, $\rho \in \mathbb{C}$ and $\sigma \in \mathbb{R}$ with $\sigma < 1$, and suppose that the one-based partial sums $A(n) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} a(k)$ satisfy $A(n) - n\rho = O(n^{\sigma})$ as $n \to \infty$. Then the linear asymptotic Dirichlet continuation $L_{a,\rho}$ of $a$ with constant $\rho$ is meromorphic at $s = 1$.
nodes.title: Meromorphy of the linear asymptotic continuation at $1$

nodes.summary: Let $a : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$, $\rho \in \mathbb{C}$ and $\sigma \in \mathbb{R}$ with $\sigma < 1$, and suppose that the one-based partial sums $A(n) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} a(k)$ satisfy $A(n) - n\rho = O(n^{\sigma})$ as $n \to \infty$. Then the linear asymptotic Dirichlet continuation $L_{a,\rho}$ of $a$ with constant $\rho$ is meromorphic at every point of the half-plane…
nodes.title: Meromorphy of the linear asymptotic continuation on a half-plane

nodes.summary: Let $a : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$, $\rho \in \mathbb{C}$ with $\rho \neq 0$ and $\sigma \in \mathbb{R}$ with $\sigma < 1$, and suppose that the one-based partial sums $A(n) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} a(k)$ satisfy $A(n) - n\rho = O(n^{\sigma})$ as $n \to \infty$. Then the meromorphic order at $s = 1$ of the linear asymptotic Dirichlet continuation $L_{a,\rho}$ of $a$ with constant $\rho$ is $-1$.
nodes.title: The linear asymptotic continuation has a simple pole at $1$

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$ with partial sums $A(n) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} f(k)$, let $\sigma$ be a real number and let $s$ be a complex number with $\sigma < \operatorname{Re} s$. If $A(n) = O(n^\sigma)$ as $n \to \infty$, then the partial sums $\sum_{n=1}^{N} f(n) n^{-s}$ converge, as $N \to \infty$, to the Abel continuation $F_f(s)$ of $f$ at $s$.
nodes.title: Abel continuation as the limit of Dirichlet partial sums

nodes.summary: Let $a : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$, $\rho \in \mathbb{C}$ and $\sigma \in \mathbb{R}$ with $\sigma < 1$, and suppose that the one-based partial sums $A(n) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} a(k)$ satisfy $A(n) - n\rho = O(n^{\sigma})$ as $n \to \infty$. Then for every $s \in \mathbb{C}$ with $\operatorname{Re} s > 1$, the partial sums $\sum_{n=1}^{N} a(n)\, n^{-s}$ converge, as $N \to \infty$, to $L_{a,\rho}(s)$, where $L_{a,\rho}$…
nodes.title: Convergence of the Dirichlet series to the linear asymptotic continuation

nodes.summary: Let $a : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$, $\rho \in \mathbb{C}$ and $\sigma \in \mathbb{R}$ with $\sigma < 1$, and suppose that the one-based partial sums $A(n) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} a(k)$ satisfy $A(n) - n\rho = O(n^{\sigma})$ as $n \to \infty$. Let $L_{a,\rho}$ be the linear asymptotic Dirichlet continuation of $a$ with constant $\rho$. Then $(s - 1)\,L_{a,\rho}(s) \to \rho$ as $s \to 1$ with $s \neq 1$.
nodes.title: Limit of the linear asymptotic continuation times $s - 1$ at $1$
Analysis

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
